entry.title: Inside LeBron and Savannah James's Home, Full of Wonderful Objects | Vogue

media:group.media:title: Inside LeBron and Savannah James's Home, Full of Wonderful Objects | Vogue
media:group.media:description:
LeBron James and Savannah James take us inside their lovely Los Angeles home and show us some of their most prized possessions. Savannah James, who co-hosts the hit podcast "Everybody's Crazy" with best friend April McDaniel, and the 76ers superstar start off with LeBron’s Vitaeris hyperbaric chamber that he uses for recovery. While Savannah claims it’s “too small," the six-foot-nine LeBron has no issue squeezing in for some all-important restoration. Next, the family moves on to LeBron’s four NBA championships with three different teams: the Lakers, Cavaliers, and Miami Heat. Savannah then proceeds to show us a skeletonized Cartier Crash that she gifted LeBron for their anniversary, as well as some comfy UGG x Palace slides that she uses for travel. The James family ends the tour by showcasing their white LeBron James Edition Mercedes-Maybach, a fully decked-out luxury car that’s one of two, with the other being auctioned off to benefit the LeBron James Family Foundation.

entry.title: KATSEYE's Daniela's Guide to Faux Freckles and Bleached Brows | Beauty Secrets | Vogue

media:group.media:title: KATSEYE's Daniela's Guide to Faux Freckles and Bleached Brows | Beauty Secrets | Vogue
media:group.media:description:
“We’re having a bleached-brow moment right now!” KATSEYE member Daniela Avanzini takes us through her beauty routine. As she gets ready, Daniela explains why Korean skin care was a game changer for her, reveals why she deleted TikTok from her phone—“I feel like if you’re iconic, you get hate”—and debates whether she might have blush blindness. She also pulls out the setting powder she’s had since filming Dream Academy, shows how she creates her signature siren eye, and compares her makeup style with fellow KATSEYE member Yoonchae’s.
